test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

He left the __watch__ on the nightstand before sleeping.

options.text: The guard was assigned to night watch duty.
The watch was ticking softly beside the lamp.
He set his digital watch to the right time.
She bought a new gold watch for her husband.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence is "**watch**," which is a homonym because it has multiple meanings.
 
• In the given context, "watch" refers to a timepiece kept on the nightstand.
 
• Option 1 – "The guard was assigned to night watch duty" uses the word "watch" in a different sense, meaning a period of observing or guarding.
 
• Other options (2, 3, and 4) refer to the same meaning of "watch" as a timepiece, so they do not qualify as using a homonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** The word "watch" in Option 1 refers to a period of surveillance or guarding, which is distinct from the meaning of "watch" as a timepiece.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Refers to the same meaning of "watch" as a timepiece.
 
• **Option 3:** Refers to a digital timepiece, which is not a homonym in this context.
 
• **Option 4:** Refers to a new gold timepiece, again, not a homonym.
 
• **Homonym:** A word that is spelled and pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning.
